relationships.description: The tag text is this relationship's 'label' property. There is no Tag node to traverse to.
Users tag users too, so a tag ranking that does not filter by target label counts both.

examples: MATCH (u:User)<-[f:FOLLOWS]-() RETURN u.name, count(f) AS followers ORDER BY followers DESC LIMIT 10
MATCH (a:User)-[:AUTHORED]->(p:Post)-[:REPLIED]->(parent:Post) WHERE a.id = $user_id RETURN p.content, parent.content LIMIT 25
MATCH (u:User)-[t:TAGGED]->(p:Post) WHERE t.indexed_at > $since RETURN t.label, count(p) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 20
MATCH (tagger:User)-[t:TAGGED]->(u:User {id: $user_id}) RETURN t.label AS reputation, count(*) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20
MATCH (u:User) WHERE toLower(u.name) CONTAINS toLower($name) OPTIONAL MATCH (u)<-[f:FOLLOWS]-() RETURN u.id AS id, u.name AS name, count(f) AS followers ORDER BY followers DESC LIMIT 10
MATCH (u:User {id: $user_id})-[:FOLLOWS]->(f:User)-[:FOLLOWS]->(u) RETURN count(DISTINCT f) AS friends
MATCH (u:User {id: $user_id})-[t:TAGGED]->(x) RETURN t.label AS tag, labels(x)[0] AS target, count(*) AS uses ORDER BY uses DESC LIMIT 20
